name: Maachah
overview: The name Maachah appears in Scripture referring to several individuals and a region, illustrating its varied significance in biblical history. Notably, Maachah is identified as the mother of King Asa, whose reign in Jerusalem was marked by faithfulness to the LORD and the removal of idolatry (1 Kings 15:10-12). Additionally, the territory of Maachathi is mentioned as a small kingdom east of Bashan, reflecting the geographical and political landscape of the time (Deuteronomy 3:14; Joshua 12:5). These references underscore Maachah’s connection both to key biblical figures and to the broader historical context of Israel’s neighbors.
